ex_vivo_detail: Perfused livers harvested from C57BL/6 mice were used in a 13C-NMR glycogenesis/glycogenolysis assay; DualAG or GLPAG was infused into the perfusate and loss of label from glycogen monitored to assess GCGR activation.
in_vitro_detail: Cell-based cAMP accumulation (Cisbio cAMP Dynamic 2, TR-FRET) in CHO cells stably expressing murine GLP1R or murine GCGR, incubated in the presence of 20% mouse plasma; also overnight incubation of peptides with human recombinant soluble DPP-4 at 37 degrees C to test protease resistance.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Plasma exposures of each peptide measured at the end of the study were comparable (inset).
concentration_time_figure.note: No figure in the body plots plasma concentration against time. The Fig. 2B inset shows terminal plasma peptide exposures at a single sampling point (24 h after the last injection) at the end of the chronic study, not a concentration-time profile. Fig. 2B itself plots cumulative body-weight change over time, not peptide concentration.

bioanalytical_method: In vitro cell-based cAMP bioassay of GLP1R agonist potency (CHO cells stably transfected with human GLP1R), quantified against a standard curve of peptide spiked into mouse plasma
bioanalytical_quote: cell-based cAMP bio-assay for determining GLP1R agonist potency was used with CHO cells stably transfected with human GLP1R to determine peptide concentrations
notes: PK values are reported only for DualAG, and only in a single RESULTS sentence: Tmax 5 h and T1/2 1.7 h after 3 mg/kg s.c. in lean C57Bl/6 mice. No error terms, no group size, no AUC and no numeric Cmax are given for the PK study; 'peak plasma peptide concentrations (Cmax) were achieved ∼5 h after subcutaneous injection' reports a time, not a concentration, so cmax is recorded as not reported. GLPAG PK is described only qualitatively as comparable to DualAG. The paper reports a single half-life without naming a phase, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and both half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are left 'not reported' per protocol; do not read 1.7 h as a fitted elimination-phase value. DISCREPANCY with the PEPLIFE2 header rows: the header lists Oxm at '~8-12 hours', but the body twice states minutes ('T1/2 ∼12 min' in INTRO, '∼8–12 min for native OXM' in RESULTS); the body value in minutes is recorded here. The header also lists the assay as RP-HPLC and ESI-MS; in the body RP-HPLC and electrospray MS were used for peptide synthesis, purification and characterisation, while plasma peptide concentrations were measured by a cell-based cAMP bioassay. Sequences were not extracted because the PEPLIFE2 header is database metadata and the body does not print the amino-acid sequences. Roles: dextrose is a metabolic challenge agent rather than a test article; the protocol role enum does not cover this, so 'other' is used. Anaesthetics (isofluorane) are procedural and are not listed as agents.
